about: The schema as ensureSchema made it on main at 92320601 (Nov 26, 2026), before payments PR 5: every table, index and trigger (sqlite_master), and its meta.schema version. purchases.test.ts runs the migration on a copy of it.
statements:
CREATE TABLE blocks (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    blocked_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, blocked_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE boss_crates (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    crate TEXT NOT NULL,
    bought_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE boss_token_drops (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    boss TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    battle TEXT NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE boss_tokens (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    boss TEXT NOT NULL,
    n INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (n >= 0),
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, boss)
  )

CREATE TABLE chat_mod_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    until INTEGER,
    by TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT,
    note TEXT,
    ended_at INTEGER,
    seen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  )

CREATE TABLE chat_picks (
    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    lines TEXT,
    emoji TEXT
  )

CREATE TABLE claw_plays (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    request TEXT NOT NULL,
    boss TEXT NOT NULL,
    won INTEGER NOT NULL,
    crate TEXT,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (user_id, request)
  )

CREATE TABLE email_codes (
    email TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    code_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    sent_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    hour_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sends_this_hour INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE engine_calls (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    day TEXT NOT NULL,
    n INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, day)
  )

CREATE TABLE equipped (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    slot TEXT NOT NULL,
    item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot)
  )

CREATE TABLE equipped_items (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    slot TEXT NOT NULL,
    item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot)
  )

CREATE TABLE fairplay_appeals (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    decided_at INTEGER,
    decided_by TEXT,
    reply TEXT
  )

CREATE TABLE fairplay_budget (
    day TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    searches INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE fairplay_cases (
    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT,
    opened_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    decided_at INTEGER,
    decided_by TEXT
  )

CREATE TABLE fairplay_devices (
    device TEXT NOT NULL,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    first_seen INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (device, user_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE fairplay_identities (
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (kind, hash, user_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE fairplay_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    by TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT
  )

CREATE TABLE fairplay_matches (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    lobby TEXT,
    mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    played_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    counted INTEGER NOT NULL,
    perf INTEGER,
    score REAL NOT NULL,
    level TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    moves TEXT,
    keep_until INTEGER
  , deep_queued INTEGER, deep_done INTEGER, would TEXT)

CREATE TABLE friend_limits (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    window_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
    n INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, kind)
  )

CREATE TABLE friend_requests (
    from_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    to_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (from_id, to_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE friends (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    friend_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    since INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, friend_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE inventory (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    acquired_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, item_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE invites (
    from_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    to_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    code TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (from_id, to_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE items (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    def TEXT NOT NULL,
    color TEXT NOT NULL,
    blemish REAL NOT NULL,
    seed INTEGER NOT NULL,
    crate TEXT NOT NULL,
    fischer INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  , color2 TEXT)

CREATE TABLE ledger (
    op_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    leg INTEGER NOT NULL,
    account TEXT NOT NULL,
    asset_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    delta INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (delta <> 0),
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_id TEXT,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    nonce TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (op_id, leg)
  )

CREATE TABLE ledger_accounts (
    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    account TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
  )

CREATE TABLE live_lobbies (
    code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    phase TEXT NOT NULL,
    humans INTEGER NOT NULL,
    alive INTEGER,
    total INTEGER,
    boss_elo INTEGER,
    started_at INTEGER,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )
CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE ops_errors (
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    hour INTEGER NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    first_seen INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sample TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (fingerprint, hour)
  )

CREATE TABLE ops_reports (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    account TEXT,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    note TEXT NOT NULL,
    diag TEXT NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE quest_days (
    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    day INTEGER NOT NULL,
    week INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reroll_day INTEGER,
    nonce TEXT NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE quest_games (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    game TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, game)
  )

CREATE TABLE quest_progress (
    quest_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    game TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (quest_id, game)
  )

CREATE TABLE quests (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    period TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    target INTEGER NOT NULL,
    assigned_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    slot INTEGER NOT NULL,
    done_at INTEGER
  , rerolled_day INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE queue_waits (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    players INTEGER NOT NULL,
    wait_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE ranked_1v1 (
    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    rating REAL NOT NULL,
    rd REAL NOT NULL,
    games INTEGER NOT NULL,
    wins INTEGER NOT NULL,
    losses INTEGER NOT NULL,
    draws INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ladder INTEGER,
    last_game TEXT,
    last_at INTEGER,
    coin_day INTEGER,
    coin_games INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    peak INTEGER,
    streak INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  )

CREATE TABLE ranked_1v1_games (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    white_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    black_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    control TEXT NOT NULL,
    result TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    moves TEXT NOT NULL,
    times TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ended_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    checked TEXT,
    nonce TEXT NOT NULL,
    white_points INTEGER,
    black_points INTEGER
  )

CREATE TABLE ranked_conduct (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    match_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    games INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    nonce TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, match_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE reports (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    reporter TEXT NOT NULL,
    target TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL
  , match TEXT, line TEXT, line_at INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE results (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    online INTEGER NOT NULL,
    placement INTEGER NOT NULL,
    players INTEGER NOT NULL,
    team TEXT,
    team_won INTEGER,
    avg_score REAL,
    rating INTEGER,
    played_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  , brilliant INTEGER, best_move TEXT, cuts INTEGER, cuts_survived INTEGER, strikes INTEGER, strikes_survived INTEGER, survived INTEGER, last_stand INTEGER, boss_elo INTEGER, boss_id TEXT, lobby TEXT, ranked INTEGER, held INTEGER, eval_bar INTEGER, abandoned INTEGER, play_ms INTEGER, moves INTEGER, xp_before INTEGER, xp_parts TEXT, xp_none TEXT, xp_rewards TEXT, coins TEXT, solo_game TEXT)

CREATE TABLE series_crates (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    crate TEXT NOT NULL,
    n INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (n >= 0),
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, crate)
  )

CREATE TABLE sessions (
    token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE solo_battles (
    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    id TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE solo_games (
    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    id TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    test_minutes INTEGER
  , real_at INTEGER, mode TEXT, players INTEGER, team TEXT, boss_id TEXT, boss_elo INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE tower_best (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    floor INTEGER NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, kind)
  )

CREATE TABLE tower_runs (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    seed INTEGER NOT NULL,
    floor INTEGER NOT NULL,
    met TEXT NOT NULL,
    members TEXT,
    fight TEXT,
    last TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE users (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    icon TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '♟',
    email TEXT UNIQUE,
    google_sub TEXT UNIQUE,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL
  , rating INTEGER, allow_invites TEXT, hide_online INTEGER, dnd INTEGER, pawn_color TEXT, age_ok_at INTEGER, chat_on INTEGER, test INTEGER, resident INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE wallets (
    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    coins INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  , crates INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, crate_keys INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, boss_picks INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE welcome_crates (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    milestone INTEGER NOT NULL,
    granted_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    games INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seen_at INTEGER,
    opened_at INTEGER,
    item_id TEXT,
    def TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, milestone)
  )
CREATE INDEX blocks_blocked ON blocks (blocked_id)
CREATE INDEX boss_crates_user ON boss_crates (user_id, crate)
CREATE INDEX boss_token_drops_user ON boss_token_drops (user_id, at)
CREATE INDEX chat_mod_log_user ON chat_mod_log (user_id, at)
CREATE INDEX fairplay_appeals_status ON fairplay_appeals (status, at)
CREATE INDEX fairplay_cases_status ON fairplay_cases (status, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX fairplay_devices_user ON fairplay_devices (user_id)
CREATE INDEX fairplay_log_user ON fairplay_log (user_id, at)
CREATE INDEX fairplay_matches_deep ON fairplay_matches (deep_queued) WHERE deep_queued = 1
CREATE INDEX fairplay_matches_keep ON fairplay_matches (keep_until)
CREATE INDEX fairplay_matches_user ON fairplay_matches (user_id, played_at)
CREATE INDEX friend_requests_to ON friend_requests (to_id)
CREATE INDEX friends_friend ON friends (friend_id)
CREATE INDEX invites_to ON invites (to_id)
CREATE INDEX items_user ON items (user_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ledger_account ON ledger (account, asset_kind, asset_id)
CREATE INDEX ledger_reason ON ledger (account, reason, created_at)
CREATE INDEX live_lobbies_updated ON live_lobbies (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX ops_errors_hour ON ops_errors (hour)
CREATE INDEX ops_reports_at ON ops_reports (at)
CREATE INDEX quest_progress_user ON quest_progress (user_id)
CREATE INDEX quests_user ON quests (user_id)
CREATE INDEX queue_waits_mode ON queue_waits (mode, at)
CREATE INDEX ranked_1v1_board ON ranked_1v1 (ladder DESC, user_id DESC) WHERE games >= 5
CREATE INDEX ranked_1v1_games_black ON ranked_1v1_games (black_id, ended_at)
CREATE INDEX ranked_1v1_games_ended ON ranked_1v1_games (ended_at)
CREATE INDEX ranked_1v1_games_white ON ranked_1v1_games (white_id, ended_at)
CREATE INDEX ranked_1v1_ladder ON ranked_1v1 (ladder)
CREATE INDEX ranked_conduct_at ON ranked_conduct (at)
CREATE INDEX ranked_conduct_user ON ranked_conduct (user_id, at)
CREATE INDEX reports_reporter ON reports (reporter, at)
CREATE INDEX reports_target ON reports (target, at)
CREATE INDEX results_user ON results (user_id, played_at)
CREATE INDEX sessions_user ON sessions (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tower_runs_open ON tower_runs (user_id, kind) WHERE status = 'open'
CREATE INDEX tower_runs_user ON tower_runs (user_id, kind)
CREATE INDEX users_name ON users (name COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE INDEX users_name_signed ON users (name COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE email IS NOT NULL OR google_sub IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX users_rating ON users (rating)
CREATE INDEX users_resident ON users (id) WHERE resident = 1
CREATE INDEX users_seen ON users (last_seen)
CREATE INDEX users_test ON users (id) WHERE test = 1
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the ledger is append-only'); END
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the ledger is append-only'); END
